# Mochizuki original-paper context for the different/conductor route

Author: Shinichi Mochizuki. Title: *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*. PDF title-page date: **February 2009**.

Official PDF: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf

Local PDF: `/home/admin-wsl/Coq/abc/refer/Mochizuki/Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position.pdf`

SHA-256: `b9dc115af61dca7fe434332ebafddf6a376a9e2926dad4e1ea2dcc0d2441f768`

HTTP HEAD 200; application/pdf; Content-Length 262332; 2026-11-14. Existing local PDF used; not downloaded.

Printed page numbers coincide with 1-based PDF page numbers.

Ghostscript txtwrite, followed by visual checking of the rasterized PDF pages. Line wrapping and typographic ligatures normalized; mathematical typography transcribed as LaTeX. Words and mathematical relation signs preserved.

**Version warning:** The existing Markdown transcription is not this PDF version: it says March 2008, while the actual PDF title page says February 2009; its Theorem 2.1 proof also differs. Do not use it as an exact-quotation source.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7i

Proposition 1.7(i), statement; printed/PDF pages: [9, 10].

(i) If we restrict functions on $Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$, $U_Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ to $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ via $\phi$, then
\[
\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E-\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_D\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Y-\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Z\lesssim\left(1-\frac{1}{e}\right)\cdot\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E
\]
on $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$.

Context (not quotation): Here φ:Y→Z is a generically finite morphism of normal Z-proper Z-flat dimension-two schemes; D and E are effective Z-flat Cartier divisors with reduced generic fibers, D_Q=φ_Q^{-1}(E_Q)_red, finite étale restriction off the divisors, and ramification indices along D_Q dividing e. The statement uses BD-class comparisons (≲), not an exact numerical finite-set inequality.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7-localClaim

Proposition 1.7(i), proof, indented elementary claim; printed/PDF pages: [10].

Fix a prime number $p$ and a positive integer $d$. Then there exists a positive integer $n$ such that for any finite Galois extension $L/K$ of finite extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ with $[L:K]\leq d$, the different ideal of $L/K$ contains $p^n\cdot\mathcal{O}_L$ [where we write $\mathcal{O}_L$ for the ring of integers of $L$].

Context (not quotation): The preceding proof paragraph reduces boundedness of the portion over a finite set Σ of log-diff_Y−log-diff_Z to this elementary local claim. This is supporting background, not the exact new finite-set conductor-extension child.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Thm2.1-BelyiDescent

Theorem 2.1, proof, first paragraph on printed page 13 (selected complete sentences); printed/PDF pages: [13].

On the other hand, by choosing appropriate normal, $\mathbb{Z}$-proper, $\mathbb{Z}$-flat models for $P$, $X$, we may apply Proposition 1.7, (i) [where we take “$e$” to be 1], to conclude that $\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_P+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_C\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_X+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E$ on $\Xi$. Also, we recall from Proposition 1.6 that $\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E\lesssim\mathrm{ht}_E\stackrel{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathrm{ht}_{\mathcal{O}_X(E)}$ on $\Xi$. Thus, by Proposition 1.4, (i), (iii), we compute to find that

Context (not quotation): On printed page 12, φ:X→P is the noncritical Belyi map unramified over U_P, C={0,1,∞}, and E=φ^{-1}(C)_red. The paragraph continues with the displayed height calculation. The first complete quoted sentence is sufficient for the different/conductor comparison route; the additional sentences show its immediate height consumer.

## Scope and fidelity

Proposition 1.7(i) and its use in Theorem 2.1 establish the paper-level geometric/BD-class different–conductor comparison used by Belyi descent.

BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension fixes F=Tripod.fieldOf(belyiImage M φ x).1 and L=x.fieldOf, finite element sets S⊂F, T⊂L, and the actual field inclusion. Under inclusion(S)⊆T it asks for finiteSetLogCond(S)≤finiteSetLogCond(T)+log(absNorm(differentIdeal(O_F,O_L)))/[L:Q].

The paper does not state this exact finite-set formula or these Lean field definitions. Treat the quoted paragraph as original-paper context, and identify the finite-set inequality as an explicit field-level arithmetic auxiliary lemma implementing that context. Do not put the exact new numeric statement inside quotation marks or claim it is a verbatim theorem of Mochizuki.

BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower separately identifies the full-field log-different with the image-field log-different plus the normalized relative different. The paper quotation does not by itself prove either current Lean child.

Recommended short citation: Mochizuki, *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*, February 2009 PDF, Theorem 2.1 proof, printed/PDF p. 13; supporting statement Proposition 1.7(i), pp. 9–10.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiDifferentConductorComparison`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $F$ be an intermediate field between $\mathbb Q$ and an algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q(T)$, with elements $u,v$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$, and $F$ is finite-dimensional of dimension $N$ over $\mathbb Q(u)$. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P\ne F$ containing every rational number; write $k_P$ for its residue field. Assume every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring and every $k_P$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. For $f\in F$, put $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$, where $V_P$ is the valuation on $F$ from the maximal ideal of $O_P$ and $\log_0$ is the integer-valued total logarithm called `WithZero.log` in the code, and put $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$. Define $e_P(f)=o_P(\mu_{\bar f}(f))$ if $f\in O_P$, where $\bar f\in k_P$ is its residue and $\mu_{\bar f}$ is its minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$; if $f\notin O_P$, define $e_P(f)=-o_P(f)$. Let $\varphi\in F$ be transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, with $e_P(\varphi)>1$ implying $P\in S$ for every $P$, where $S=\{P:o_P(\varphi)\ne0\text{ or }o_P(\varphi-1)>0\}$. Assume $S$ is finite, with its finiteness proof supplied as data, and let $E(P)=1$ on $S$ and $E(P)=0$ elsewhere. Let $G\subset F$ be a finite set whose generated $\mathbb Q$-subalgebra is exactly $\{f\in F: f\in O_P\text{ for all }P\notin S\}$ and which contains $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(1-\varphi)^{-1}$. A point $x$ consists of such a place $P_x$ and a ring homomorphism $\sigma_x:k_{P_x}\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$; for $f\in O_{P_x}$ write $f(x)=\sigma_x(\bar f)$, put $L_x=\sigma_x(k_{P_x})$ and $d_x=[L_x:\mathbb Q]$. Let $A$ be any bijection from the points $x$ for which $u,v\in O_{P_x}$ and $u(x),v(x)\ne0$ to the pairs $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb Q}^{2}$ with $a^N+b^N=1$ and $a,b\ne0$, such that $A(x)=(u(x),v(x))$ for every choice of regularity proofs and $L_x=\mathbb Q(a,b)$. Write $x_p$ for the underlying point of $A^{-1}(p)$, $F_p=\mathbb Q(a,b)$ and $d_p=[F_p:\mathbb Q]$. For $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$ let $\mu_z$ be its minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$ and put $d_z=\deg(\mu_z)$, $\Delta(z)=\log|\operatorname{disc}\mathbb Q(z)|/d_z$, and $c(z)=d_z^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{w(z)\ne1\,\lor\,w(z-1)\ne1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$ over finite places of $\mathbb Q(z)$. Define $c_G(x)=0$ if some $g\in G$ is not in $O_{P_x}$; otherwise define $c_G(x)=d_x^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{\exists g\in G:\,w(g(x))>1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$, over all finite places $w$ of $L_x$, using the finite-support sum (which is defined to be zero when the summand has infinite support). Thus only the strict inequality $w(g(x))>1$ is counted. The conclusion below concerns only $p$ for which $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ and $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$. The code defines its image to be $z_p$ in this case, and the rational number $2$ otherwise; the latter branch is outside the conclusion's hypotheses. There exists $C\in\mathbb R$, independent of $p$, such that for every such good-value pair $p$, $\Delta(z_p)+c(z_p)\le\log|\operatorname{disc}F_p|/d_p+c_G(x_p)+C$. No hypothesis $N>3$ is imposed, and $C$ may depend on all the fixed model, discreteness, finite-residue, affine-identification, function, finite-cusp, and generator data. Here $\mathfrak p_w$ is the maximal ideal associated with the finite place $w$, and its norm is the absolute ideal norm.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiDifferentConductorComparison`

设 $N$ 为自然数，$F$ 为 $\mathbb Q$ 与 $\mathbb Q(T)$ 的一个代数闭包之间的中间域，且有元素 $u,v$ 满足：$u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越，$u^N+v^N=1$，$F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$，并且 $F$ 在 $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限维且维数为 $N$。这里的位 $P$ 是包含所有有理数且不等于 $F$ 的赋值子环 $O_P$，其剩余域记为 $k_P$。假设每个 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环，每个 $k_P$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上都有限维。对 $f\in F$，令 $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$，其中 $V_P$ 是由 $O_P$ 的极大理想给出的 $F$ 上的赋值，$\log_0$ 是代码中名为 `WithZero.log` 的取整数值的全定义对数；再令 $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$。若 $f\in O_P$，令 $e_P(f)=o_P(\mu_{\bar f}(f))$，其中 $\bar f\in k_P$ 是 $f$ 的剩余类，$\mu_{\bar f}$ 是它在 $\mathbb Q$ 上的最小多项式；若 $f\notin O_P$，则令 $e_P(f)=-o_P(f)$。设 $\varphi\in F$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越，且对每个 $P$，若 $e_P(\varphi)>1$ 则 $P\in S$，其中 $S=\{P:o_P(\varphi)\ne0\text{ 或 }o_P(\varphi-1)>0\}$。假设 $S$ 有限，并给定其有限性的证明；令 $E$ 在 $S$ 上取值为 $1$，其余处取值为 $0$。设有限集 $G\subset F$ 生成的 $\mathbb Q$ 子代数恰为 $\{f\in F: \text{对所有 }P\notin S,\ f\in O_P\}$，并且 $G$ 包含 $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(1-\varphi)^{-1}$。点 $x$ 由这样的位 $P_x$ 及环同态 $\sigma_x:k_{P_x}\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成；当 $f\in O_{P_x}$ 时，记 $f(x)=\sigma_x(\bar f)$，并令 $L_x=\sigma_x(k_{P_x})$、$d_x=[L_x:\mathbb Q]$。设 $A$ 为任意双射，将满足 $u,v\in O_{P_x}$ 且 $u(x),v(x)\ne0$ 的点 $x$ 映到满足 $a^N+b^N=1$ 且 $a,b\ne0$ 的数对 $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb Q}^{2}$，并要求对每种正则性证明都有 $A(x)=(u(x),v(x))$，且 $L_x=\mathbb Q(a,b)$。记 $x_p$ 为 $A^{-1}(p)$ 的底层点，$F_p=\mathbb Q(a,b)$，$d_p=[F_p:\mathbb Q]$。对 $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$，令 $\mu_z$ 为其在 $\mathbb Q$ 上的最小多项式，$d_z=\deg(\mu_z)$、$\Delta(z)=\log|\operatorname{disc}\mathbb Q(z)|/d_z$，并令 $c(z)=d_z^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{w(z)\ne1\,\lor\,w(z-1)\ne1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$，其中遍历 $\mathbb Q(z)$ 的有限位。若某个 $g\in G$ 不属于 $O_{P_x}$，令 $c_G(x)=0$；否则令 $c_G(x)=d_x^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{\exists g\in G:\,w(g(x))>1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$，其中遍历 $L_x$ 的所有有限位 $w$，使用有限支撑求和，求和项的支撑无限时该和按定义为零。因此只有严格不等式 $w(g(x))>1$ 被计入。下面的结论仅涉及满足 $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ 且 $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$ 的 $p$。代码在这种情形把其像定义为 $z_p$，否则定义为有理数 $2$；后一分支不满足此结论的假设。存在不依赖 $p$ 的 $C\in\mathbb R$，使每个这样的良好取值数对 $p$ 都满足 $\Delta(z_p)+c(z_p)\le\log|\operatorname{disc}F_p|/d_p+c_G(x_p)+C$。没有假设 $N>3$；$C$ 可以依赖所有固定的模型、离散性、剩余域有限维性、仿射对应、函数、有限尖点及生成元数据。这里 $\mathfrak p_w$ 是有限位 $w$ 对应的极大理想，其范数指理想的绝对范数。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiDifferentConductorComparison`

自然数 $N$ に対し、$F$ を $\mathbb Q$ と $\mathbb Q(T)$ の代数閉包の間の中間体とし、$u,v\in F$ が、$u$ は $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的、$u^N+v^N=1$、$F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$、および $F$ は $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限次元でその次元は $N$、という条件を満たすとする。ここで素点 $P$ とは、すべての有理数を含み $F$ と異なる付値部分環 $O_P$ をいい、その剰余体を $k_P$ と書く。すべての $O_P$ が離散付値環であり、すべての $k_P$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元であると仮定する。$f\in F$ に対し $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$ と置く。ただし $V_P$ は $O_P$ の極大イデアルによる $F$ 上の付値、$\log_0$ はコードで `WithZero.log` と呼ばれる整数値の全域的対数である。また $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$ と置く。$f\in O_P$ のとき、その剰余類 $\bar f\in k_P$ の $\mathbb Q$ 上の最小多項式を $\mu_{\bar f}$ とし、$e_P(f)=o_P(\mu_{\bar f}(f))$ と定める。$f\notin O_P$ のときは $e_P(f)=-o_P(f)$ と定める。$\varphi\in F$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的であり、各 $P$ で $e_P(\varphi)>1$ ならば $P\in S$ を満たすとする。ただし $S=\{P:o_P(\varphi)\ne0\text{ または }o_P(\varphi-1)>0\}$ である。$S$ は有限で、その有限性の証明も与えられているとする。$E$ を $S$ 上で $1$、それ以外で $0$ を取る関数とする。有限集合 $G\subset F$ が生成する $\mathbb Q$ 部分代数は、ちょうど $\{f\in F: \text{すべての }P\notin S\text{ で }f\in O_P\}$ であり、$G$ は $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(1-\varphi)^{-1}$ を含むとする。点 $x$ は、そのような素点 $P_x$ と環準同型 $\sigma_x:k_{P_x}\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ の組である。$f\in O_{P_x}$ のとき $f(x)=\sigma_x(\bar f)$ と書き、$L_x=\sigma_x(k_{P_x})$、$d_x=[L_x:\mathbb Q]$ と置く。$u,v\in O_{P_x}$ かつ $u(x),v(x)\ne0$ を満たす点 $x$ から、$a^N+b^N=1$ かつ $a,b\ne0$ を満たす組 $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb Q}^{2}$ への任意の全単射 $A$ を取る。どの正則性の証明を用いても $A(x)=(u(x),v(x))$ であり、$L_x=\mathbb Q(a,b)$ であることを要求する。$A^{-1}(p)$ の台となる点を $x_p$、$F_p=\mathbb Q(a,b)$、$d_p=[F_p:\mathbb Q]$ と書く。$z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$ に対し、その $\mathbb Q$ 上の最小多項式を $\mu_z$ とし、$d_z=\deg(\mu_z)$、$\Delta(z)=\log|\operatorname{disc}\mathbb Q(z)|/d_z$、$c(z)=d_z^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{w(z)\ne1\,\lor\,w(z-1)\ne1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$ と置く。$w$ は $\mathbb Q(z)$ の有限素点全体を動く。ある $g\in G$ が $O_{P_x}$ に属さなければ $c_G(x)=0$ とし、それ以外では $c_G(x)=d_x^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{\exists g\in G:\,w(g(x))>1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$ と定める。ここで $w$ は $L_x$ の有限素点全体を動き、有限台の和を用いる。この和は被加算関数の台が無限であれば定義により零である。したがって厳密な不等式 $w(g(x))>1$ のみを数える。以下の結論は $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ かつ $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$ を満たす $p$ のみに関する。コードはこの場合の像を $z_p$、それ以外の像を有理数 $2$ と定義するが、後者の分岐は結論の仮定に含まれない。$p$ に依存しない実数 $C$ が存在し、そのような良い値をもつすべての組 $p$ について $\Delta(z_p)+c(z_p)\le\log|\operatorname{disc}F_p|/d_p+c_G(x_p)+C$ が成り立つ。$N>3$ は仮定しない。$C$ は固定したモデル、離散性、剰余体の有限次元性、アフィン同定、関数、有限尖点集合、および生成元の全データに依存してよい。ここで $\mathfrak p_w$ は有限素点 $w$ に対応する極大イデアルであり、そのノルムはイデアルの絶対ノルムである。
